# The Auditable Truth API & MCP for Modern Fintechs

One stable endpoint. A native MCP server. Audit-grade FX proof your sales team — or your AI agents — deliver in under 30 seconds.

Every FX audit you run today is part of the Vision FX foundation — the dataset that will power real-time anomaly detection for your stack.

Built to become the FX signal layer behind future broker, treasury, and automation workflows.

Empower your sales team in minutes.

REST APIJSON responsesWebhooksProduction-ready

### Powered by iPayX AI Engine

iPayX AI Engine reads bank statements, detects FX spreads, and returns structured JSON output. Every audit response includes a confidence score and spread benchmark.

## The world's first MCP-native FX audit engine

Plug iPayX directly into Claude Desktop, Cursor, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Perplexity, n8n. Your AI agents can audit an FX transfer, verify a rate, or generate a forensic report — without leaving their tool.

`check_fx_rate`
Live mid-market rate + spread analysis (public)

`audit_transaction`
Score 1-10, spread %, hidden fees (public, 10/IP/7d)

`full_forensic_report`
Full forensic report + Proof-Link (API key)

## FX Audit — Quickstart

Here are three common ways to plug iPayX into your product.

### FX broker / multi-currency platform

Send each client FX conversion (CAD→USD, EUR→CAD, etc.) to the iPayX API and return a 0–10 FX score with estimated hidden costs.

### Corporate treasury

Feed your international payments (supplier invoices) into iPayX to compare bank rates vs mid-market and track margin impact.

### Accounting firm / fractional CFO

Use the API to audit your clients' FX conversions at year-end and generate a standardized report with score and potential savings.

Connect your data

## Three ways to send your transactions

Pick the source that fits your stack. All converge into the same FX audit engine.

### Universal bank coverage — anywhere Plaid does not reach

Plaid covers US and CA institutions. For any other region — or when a connection fails — iPayX accepts **any bank statement in PDF or CSV, worldwide** — no degraded experience for your prospects.

Plaid: US/CAPDF/CSV: Worldwide, any bank

## Get started in 3 steps

1

### Create your account

Access your dashboard and generate your production API key.

2

### Copy your API key

Authenticate using a Bearer token from your backend.

3

### Send your first request

Post transaction data to the FX audit endpoint and receive a structured JSON response.

## First request

Direct API endpoint. Custom domain api.ipayx.ai coming soon.

bash

```
# POST /v1/audit — see "Partner Rate Comparison" section for optional partner_rate field
curl -X POST https://hvujzsdwcoweirroubeh.supabase.co/functions/v1/fx-audit-engine \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ipx_live_your_key" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "transactions": [
    {
      "id": "tx_001",
      "source_currency": "USD",
      "target_currency": "EUR",
      "source_amount": 1000000,
      "target_amount": 1018900,
      "trade_timestamp": "2026-04-15T14:30:00Z"
    }
  ]
}'
```

## Authentication

Authenticate every request using your production API key in the Authorization header.

`Authorization: Bearer ipx_live_your_key`

Generate and manage your key in the Dashboard. Keys are server-side credentials and must never be exposed in client-side code.

## Your Competitive Rate — Partner Configuration

HOW PARTNER SCORING WORKS

When your API key makes an audit call, iPayX scores the client's bank rate AND your competitive rate — separately.

Example:

 Client bank spread → 1.89% above mid → FX Score 1/10

 OFX configured rate → 0.80% above mid → FX Score 5/10 (+4 improvement)

 Airwallex configured → 0.50% above mid → FX Score 7/10 (+6 improvement)

The client sees two scores. You don't fight the bank. You show the math. The client decides.
